description:
Watch Jess Williamson perform "A Mile South of Heaven" live at the Forum at MPR, home of The Current
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Singer-songwriter Jess Williamson’s new album, “A Mile South of Heaven,” released on Friday, Oct. 9. In the weeks leading up to the album’s release, Williamson visited The Current to record a session in the Forum at Minnesota Public Radio. Recorded in front of a live audience, Williamson performed solo acoustic versions of four songs off the new record. She also sat down for an interview with The Current’s Mac Wilson to talk about the album, about splitting time between Texas and Los Angeles, and working with producer Shooter Jennings — and Jennings’ interesting connection to Prince.
